data.name: Lucarion
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin word "lucaris", meaning "bringer of light". This name was often given to those who brought light to their communities through acts of courage and wisdom. In Christianity, it is also associated with St. Lucian, a third-century martyr who was known for his unwavering faith and courage in the face of persecution.

in_hebrew.name: לוקריון
in_hebrew.long_meaning: לוקריון הוא שם שמקורו ביוונית ומשמעותו 'מוביל אור' או 'נולד מאור האלוהים'. השם לוקריון קשור למילה היוונית 'לוקוס' שפירושה אור, ויכול להיות קשור לנושאי תאולוגיה נוצרית הקשורים לאור ולישועה.

in_greek.name: Λουκάριον
in_greek.long_meaning: Τὸ Λουκάριον προέρχεται ἐκ τῆς λέξεως Λουκᾶς, ἡ οποία σημαίνει 'φέρω φῶς' ἤ 'ἀπὸ τὸ φῶς τοῦ Θεοῦ'. Ἡ ἐτυμολογία αὐτοῦ τοῦ ονόματος συνδέεται μέ τήν πνευματική καθοδήγηση καί τό φῶς τοῦ Θεοῦ.

in_latin.name: Lucarion
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Lucarion derivatur ex vocibus Latinis 'lux' et 'Dei', quae significant 'Dei lux' vel 'luminaria'. Hoc nomen in traditione Christiana saepe ad illuminationem spiritualem et salvationem refertur.

historical_references.reference: Saint Lucarion of Cagliari was a bishop of Cagliari, Sardinia, during the late 3rd and early 4th centuries. He is said to have suffered martyrdom under the Roman emperor Diocletian. According to legend, he was a young man of noble birth who converted many to Christianity in the region. When Diocletian's persecution of Christians began, Lucarion was seized and subjected to various tortures, including being thrown into a cauldron of boiling oil. He survived unharmed and was eventually beheaded. His feast day is celebrated on October 13.
historical_references.context: Roman Empire, Sardinia, Persecution of Christians

historical_references.reference: Saint Lucarion of Siponto was a bishop of Siponto, Apulia, who lived during the 5th century. He is remembered as a protector of the city from naval attacks and as a healer. His most famous miracle involved curing a man suffering from dropsy, an ailment that caused the swelling of limbs.
